basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old graphic designer from Austin, Texas. I recently got into collecting baseball cards after finding my dad's old collection in our attic. I work full-time, so I usually browse Reddit in the evenings around 8-10 PM CST. I'm single and enjoy spending my weekends at local card shops or trading events. Besides baseball cards, I'm also interested in cryptocurrency and military history. I dislike negativity in communities and prefer to engage in positive and constructive discussions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a growing knowledge of baseball card collecting, primarily learning through YouTube videos, community forums, and in-person advice from local card shop owners. I also have a moderate understanding of cryptocurrency markets, self-taught through online resources.
